beats.say: Ooh! A mystery egg! What's inside?
What do you think it is?
Baby crocodiles call out from inside their eggs!
It tells their mom it's time to dig them out!

sources.fact: Baby crocodiles call from inside their eggs when it is time to hatch; the calls tell their siblings and tell the mother it is time to dig her babies out

post.instagram_caption:
Wibbo found a mystery egg that goes umph! Is it a flower? A tree? No, Wibbo!

It's a baby crocodile! Baby crocodiles call out from inside their eggs, and that tells their mom it's time to dig them out.

Silly Wibbo. Smart kids.

What did YOU think was inside the egg?
